name: Hawaii
summary: Statutes: data.capitol.hawaii.gov serves the HRS (2025 ed.) as one static HTML file per section, constructible from the chapter via the volume-folder range table; the www.capitol.hawaii.gov host is Cloudflare-challenged for scripts, and Justia (2025) is the tier-2 fallback. Constitution: per-section files on the same host, plus a one-page LRB text. Court rules are HTML/PDF on courts.state.hi.us, which refuses the script route and truncates in WebFetch (HRCP at Rule 17, HRAP at Rule 32 after two windows); the Rules of Evidence are statute (HRS ch. 626). HAR has no central official site (agency PDFs via the Lt. Governor's directory; Cornell LII mirrors per section); there is no administrative register. Case law: the Judiciary's opinions listing (2010-) is GET-filterable by year but has no docket search and serves slip PDFs; Justia covers 1980- ICA and Supreme Court by docket slug. Cert dockets reuse the ICA number (CAAP-YY-N → SCWC-YY-N).

citation_map.notes: One code: HRS sections are 'chapter-section' (657-7, 708-821, 514B-1, 657-1.5) and the Insurance Code uses 'chapter:article-section' (431:10C-301); a range 'HRS §§ 657-7 to -13' is read as its first section. 'HRS' and 'Haw. Rev. Stat.' mark Hawaii; bare 'section 657-7' does not route without 'Hawaii Revised Statutes'/'HRS'. The Hawaii Rules of Evidence are codified in HRS § 626-1 (one file per rule; law_aliases map HRE → 626-1) and route to the statute sources. Court rules are cited 'HRCP Rule 12(b)(6)', 'HRAP Rule 40.1', 'HRPP Rule 48', 'RSCH 2.12', 'HRPC Rule 1.7' in Hawai'i opinions and 'Haw. R. Civ. P.' in Bluebook; bare 'Rule 12(b)(6)' never routes here. Hawai'i spellings vary: Hawaii, Hawai'i, Hawaiʻi, Hawai`i — all regexes accept them. Reporters: Haw. vols. 1-75 to 1994, then 'Hawai'i' 76+ (Bluebook 'Haw.'); Haw. App. 1-10 (1980-1994), after which ICA opinions appear in Hawai'i Reports; parallel P.2d/P.3d. No public-domain citation. Docket prefixes: SCWC (cert), SCAP (transfer), SCPW (writs), SCAD/SCPR (discipline/admission), SCOT, SCEC, SCCQ (certified questions), CAAP (ICA); pre-2010 five-digit numbers. Unpublished ICA SDOs and memorandum opinions are cited with WL and '(SDO)'/'(mem. op.)'; HRAP 35(c) governs citing them (rule text not reached). 'cert. rejected' is the Hawai'i form for denial of certiorari; the generic markers '(SDO)' and 'cert. granted' patterns are context_required. CourtListener ids 'haw' and 'hawapp' are from memory, unverified.

sources.title: Hawaii Revised Statutes (Legislature, data.capitol.hawaii.gov)
sources.publisher: Hawaii State Legislature / Legislative Reference Bureau (Revisor of Statutes)
sources.official_status_evidence: No official/unofficial statement found on the HRS browse pages (hrsall/AllDivisions.aspx, hrsall/Default.aspx) or section pages; the bound HRS and supplements are published by the Revisor (LRB). No UELMA statement seen.
sources.coverage: Current HRS (labelled 'Hawaii Revised Statutes 2025'; files last-modified 6 Jan 2026), one static HTML file per section, with annotations (AG opinions, law reviews, case notes) on the same page. Includes Hawaii Rules of Evidence as HRS ch. 626 (§ 626-1, one file per rule) and the State Constitution (Vol01 05-CONST). Prior editions under /hrsarchive/hrs{YYYY}/ (1999 onward seen).

access.pattern_rules: chapter = digits zero-padded to 4 plus any upper-case letter suffix (657 → 0657, 514B → 0514B, 42F → 0042F). section = integer part zero-padded to 4; a decimal section appends '_' + the decimal digits zero-padded to 4 (657-1.5 → HRS_0657-0001_0005; 657-7.3 → HRS_0657-0007_0003). Insurance Code style '431:10C-301' → HRS_0431-0010C-0301.htm in folder HRS0431 (article padded to 4 incl. letter). Rules of Evidence: HRE Rule N = § 626-1 Rule N → HRS0626/HRS_0626-0001-{rule:04d}.htm (Rule 702.1 → HRS_0626-0001-0702_0001.htm). Chapter table of contents: HRS_{chapter}-.htm. volume_folder is chosen from the chapter by range (the folder names carry the ranges, from https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/hrscurrent/): Vol01_Ch0001-0042F (ch. 1-42F, also 05-CONST), Vol02_Ch0046-0115, Vol03_Ch0121-0200D, Vol04_Ch0201-0257, Vol05_Ch0261-0319, Vol06_Ch0321-0344, Vol07_Ch0346-0398, Vol08_Ch0401-0429, Vol09_Ch0431-0435H, Vol10_Ch0436-0474, Vol11_Ch0476-0490, Vol12_Ch0501-0588, Vol13_Ch0601-0676, Vol14_Ch0701-0853. Lettered chapters sort after their number (431A..431S in Vol09; 0042F ends Vol01).
access.navigation: Fallback: hrscurrent/ (IIS directory listing; volume folders) → HRS{chapter} folder listing → section file. Human browse: hrsall/AllDivisions.aspx → Division.aspx?id=N (shows titles with chapter ranges, e.g. Title 36 = ch. 651-676) → ChaptersByDivision.aspx?id=N. Indexes show chapter ranges, not section ranges; chapter TOC file HRS_{chapter}-.htm lists sections.

automation.notes: WebFetch returned body text for a search-result URL (HRS_0708-0821.htm) but a constructed URL (HRS_0657-0007.htm) failed with PROVENANCE_REQUIRED — read built URLs with fetch_doc.py. The www.capitol.hawaii.gov host (same /hrscurrent paths) is behind a Cloudflare challenge for the shell — use data.capitol.hawaii.gov only. Section pages carry long annotations after the text (657-7 page 18,294 chars).
